variants.text: Middle-aged male with an oval face, receding hairline, and short dark hair.
Middle-aged male with an oval face, receding hairline, short dark hair, and a clean-shaven face with straight-on head pose.

Middle-aged male, oval face with balanced structure, high wide forehead with receding hairline at temples, medium thick soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double creases, straight-bridged nose with rounded tip, medium width mouth with thin upper lip, and short dark hair styled backward; clean-shaven.

A middle-aged man with short dark hair that's styled back. He has an oval-shaped face, a clean-shaven look, and a high forehead with a receding hairline. He has medium-thick eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes.
